verdicts.reason: A squeezes all the content into a cramped middle band, leaving a large dead area above and a huge empty gap before the legal text. Its headline is too small to lead, the CTA is pushed right and doesn't line up with the left-aligned text, and the three pills are on inconsistent left edges (Honey Rosemary is offset), so the layout looks random. B uses the tall format properly, with a large headline that clearly leads and a full-width CTA. Its flaws: an oversized gap between the headline and the subcopy, the flavour order reversed from the original (Honey Rosemary now first), centred pills of different widths that don't match the left-aligned text, and the wordmark sitting on the decorative circle.
